Text.Text: Worldbreaker trial: closed. Structural rating: confirmed. No further action required of this unit. Maintain rating.
Staff proficiency below rank 50. This unit cannot recommend the assignment. Complete your training and return; the suspected structural faults are unlikely to improve without intervention.

Your staff handling merits evaluation. Six Worldbreaker adepts are testing structural failure in the Breaker Bay on CZ-220. Their subjects include people. Defeat the six and recover their work order. This unit requires the original calculations, before further damage obscures them.
Access key issued. Travel to CZ-220's maintenance level and enter the Breaker Bay. This unit will remain here at the gym to receive the work order.

Worldbreaker is force that exceeds rated tolerance, applied with intent. A push becomes a break at a calculable threshold. This unit calculates that threshold continuously. Most organics do not, which is why the yard keeps producing structural failures.

Travel to CZ-220's maintenance level. The Breaker Bay entrance accepts the issued key. Gather any additional operators at the entrance before passing through; this unit would prefer the team to arrive together.
Six operators. Improvised staff strikes, inconsistent follow-through. Low structural risk to a prepared operator. High structural risk to an unprepared one. Recommend preparation.
Six adepts in the Breaker Bay on CZ-220. Recover their work order and return to this unit at Dantooine's Battle Monster Gym.
Six operators corrected. Work order detected on your person. Transfer it.
Work order logged. First structural checkpoint: passed. Compensation transferred. Priority: correction. Secondary priority: your continued function. First priority: the data.

Five specialists are using the junkline relay to alter the bay's loads. Defeat the five in the Breaker Bay and recover it. The machinery was not rated for their experiments. Neither were the personnel.
Return to the Breaker Bay on CZ-220. Recover the relay. Avoid standing beneath equipment whose load has been altered.
Calibrated force requires a calibrated response. These specialists have removed the guesswork the first group carried. You should remove yours as well.
The same Breaker Bay on CZ-220. Your key grants entry. The five specialists control the relay there; recover it and return to this unit on Dantooine.
Five specialists. Consistent form, minor variance in follow-through. Structural risk: moderate. This unit rates their probability of a clean hit above the previous group's, by a measurable margin.
Five specialists in the Breaker Bay control the junkline relay. Recover it after their defeat.
Five specialists corrected. Relay signature detected. Transfer it.
Relay logged. Bay power rerouting corrected. Second structural checkpoint: passed.

The warden is holding the Breaker Bay. Use its challenge marker, defeat her, and recover the sheared bay sigil. Additional operators are recommended. A second observer may detect the failure point while your attention is occupied.
Acknowledged. Use the Breaker Bay challenge marker to call the warden. Additional operators are advisable. Recover the sigil and return to this unit.

Her technique demands precision this unit rates above the specialists' by a wide margin. One miscalculated block, and the failure is structural, not superficial. This unit does not recommend testing that alone.
The Breaker Bay on CZ-220. Use its challenge marker to call the warden. She does not patrol; she responds when challenged. This distinction may be useful when preparing.
This unit recommends assistance. A second operator can observe a strike while the first is occupied surviving it. Choose someone whose observations you trust.
Use the Breaker Bay challenge marker to call the warden. Defeat her and recover the bay sigil. Additional operators remain advisable.
Warden corrected. Sigil signature detected, sheared but intact. Transfer it.
Sigil logged. Third structural checkpoint: passed. Operator survival rate: acceptable. Function noted.

Four supervisors still control the quartermaster's override chip. They have removed limits they do not understand. Defeat the four in the Breaker Bay and recover it. This unit would prefer to restore the limits before testing the remaining structure.
Recover the override chip from the four supervisors. Defeat each; simultaneous elimination is unnecessary.

The four supervisors cover one another's openings. Removing one reduces the others' coverage. They need not be defeated simultaneously. This unit recommends beginning with an opening you can use safely.
The four supervisors remain in the Breaker Bay on CZ-220. Recover their override chip, then return to this unit on Dantooine.
Four simultaneous vectors of force. This unit's model does not recommend a one-operator response to a four-operator formation. Match their number, or approximate it.
Four supervisors in the Breaker Bay hold the override chip. Recover it and return to this unit.
Four units corrected. Override chip signature detected. Transfer it.
Chip logged. Unlogged bay activity terminated. Fourth structural checkpoint: passed. One checkpoint remains.

The master is in the Breaker Yard. Use the challenge marker to call it, then defeat it. Its governor has been disabled. Return to this unit at the Battle Monster Gym afterward; your survival will provide useful information absent from its calculations.
Acknowledged. Use the Breaker Yard challenge marker to call the master. This unit will await your report at the Battle Monster Gym.

It demands you understand what exceeding your own rating means. This unit is not permitted to exceed its own rating; the safety governor prevents it. The master's governor, whatever it was, did not hold. This unit does not know what replaces a governor that fails. Neither, this unit suspects, does the master.
The Breaker Yard on CZ-220. Use its challenge marker to call the master. Its position for the trial is known; its response to you is less predictable.

Apply force beyond safe tolerance. Repeatedly. Additional operators are recommended, but not required. This unit advises watching the recovery after each committed strike. Even a disabled governor cannot remove the need to reposition.
The master's challenge marker is in the Breaker Yard. Defeat it, then return to the Battle Monster Gym on Dantooine.
The master is no longer generating readings. No further correction required. Confirm status.
The unsafe trials have ceased. Your payment is authorized. This unit is prepared to instruct you in Worldbreaker. Its first recommendation is to understand a load limit before deciding to exceed it.
Back to the job.
Six operators, one work order. I'm on it.
What exactly is Worldbreaker?
Where do I find them?
What am I walking into?
Not yet.
Here's the work order.
Back to the job.
Five specialists. Understood.
What's different about them?
Same bay?
What should I expect this time?
Give me a moment.
Here's the relay.
Back to the job.
I'll challenge the warden.
What makes her different?
Where do I find her?
How many should I bring?
I need to find the right people first.
Here's the sigil. The warden's down.
Back to the job.
I'll match their numbers.
Why does the formation matter?
Where do they hold?
How many should I bring?
I need time to prepare.
Here's the chip. All four are down.
Back to the job.
I'll face the master.
What happened to its governor?
Where do I find it?
What's it going to do to us?
I need to find people willing to come.
It's done. No more readings.
